MAYOR’S FUND SUBCOMMITTEE MINUTES

Kimberly Lewis, Member  Stephen Wood, Member
Julie Lie, Member

  FINISHED AGENDA & MINUTES

CALL TO ORDER

At 2:02 p.m., chair Jim Howat called the meeting to order.

ROLL CALL

  Commissioners Present: Howat, Lewis

Also present: Stephanie Sosa, Community Program Specialist, Jennifer Santana, Secretary,
Paul Duncan, Homeless Services Bureau Manager.

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  24-54983  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Mayor’s Fund Subcommittee
  meeting of Monday, August 26, 2024.

  A motion was made by Member Rew, seconded by Member Howat, to approve
  recommendation. The motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  2  Howat, Rew
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 1  Lewis

2.  24-54984  Recommendation to receive and file the Mayor’s Fund Update.

  • The total contributions for July were $73
  • There are outstanding grants for precious lamb and urban community
  outreach and two agencies recently awarded.
  • Public comment discussion took place about the church's support for
  Precious Lamb.

  A motion was made by Member Rew, seconded by Member Howat, to approve

3.  24-54988  Recommendation to review and edit the Mayor’s Fund Standard operating
  procedures (SOP) for new applicants.

  • Member Rew outlined the existing draft of the SOP evaluation criteria and
  noted that the committee should review it.
  • Members of the subcommittee and staff discussed the edits needed for the
  draft. Member Rew will finalize it with the suggested changes. Once the final
  draft is complete, staff will send it to the mayor’s office for approval, after
  which it will be presented at the larger HSAC meeting for final consideration.
  • No public comment.

  A motion was made by Member Howat, seconded by Member Rew, to approve
  recommendation. The motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  2  Howat, Rew
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 1  Lewis

4.  24-54985  Recommendation to review and edit the Mayor’s Fund utilities bill flyer.

  • Member Lewis was not present, the utility bill flyer draft will be reviewed at
  the next scheduled meeting.
  • Members present discussed moving forward with the utility envelope if no
  flyer is presented next month.
  • No public comment.

  A motion was made by Member Howat, seconded by Member Rew, to approve
  recommendation. The motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  2 Howat, Rew
  No:  0 None
  Recused: 0 None

5.  24-54986  Recommendation to review and edit the draft notice for the Mayor’s Fund
  organization that will be featured in the press telegram.

  • Member Rew has reached out to her contact at the press telegram regarding
  the Mayor’s Fund organization notice. Member Rew is waiting on a response
  and hopes to have more information during the next scheduled meeting.
  • No public comment.

  A motion was made by Member Rew, seconded by Member Howat, to approve
  recommendation. The motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  2  Howat, Rew
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 1  Lewis

6.  24-54987  Recommendation to discuss and approve future agenda items.

  • City Staff Stephanie Sosa informed the committee that His Little Feet Inc.
  has reapplied for the Mayor’s Fund and the application packet will be sent
  out once the initial review is completed.
  • No public comment.

  A motion was made by Member Howat, seconded by Member Rew, to approve
  recommendation. The motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  2  Howat, Rew
